messages:
Sasha (incidents): Quick thread to lock customer comms for yesterday's outage. Need: statuspage phrasing, 72h summary owner, and RCA sharing policy (consent/redaction). Who takes which?
incident-bot: Postmortem created: /postmortems/pm-2026-03-cache-rollout (unassigned)
Mike Ops: I can do statuspage + 72h placeholder. Draft idea: short cause, mitigation, one-line "what we did to protect customers", and link for requesting full RCA.
Olivia Support: Support will own outreach. Need an Intercom-ready template and a simple decision tree for high-touch customers. Last time they wanted ETA, include it.
Priya Legal: Default public summary = redacted. Full technical RCA = available on request under consent. I'll provide a redaction checklist and consent matrix.
Jamie Product: Noting recurring pattern: rollout + cache warmup. I'll add a rollout verification item to postmortem checklist and suggest a rate-limit guard.
Console Team: Can add incident metadata flag rca_share_allowed (boolean). Small ticket queued.
Sasha (incidents): Action items: mike_ops publish statuspage + 72h placeholder (due 2167700120); olivia_support draft Intercom template (due 2167700200); priya_legal post redaction checklist + consent matrix (due 2167700280); jamie_product add checklist + guard (due 2167700360). Reply with ":+1:" to claim.
Mike Ops: :+1: Taking statuspage. Will publish and ping here.
Olivia Support: :+1: Template and escalation tree coming in ~90m.
Priya Legal: :+1: Redaction checklist and consent steps by EOD.
Jamie Product: :+1: Adding checklist items now.
Sasha (incidents): Please include a one-line FAQ on the statuspage about how to request full RCA (contact support + consent link). We'll check status in the follow-up meeting in 48-72h. Thanks all.
